leftEvidence.title: The man is sent out and the garden is guarded

points.label: Place and later condition
points.left: The LORD God speaks of the man knowing good and evil, sends him to work the ground, drives him out, and guards the tree-of-life way.
points.right: The speaker says the present world became narrow, sorrowful, perilous, and toilsome when Adam transgressed.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Tree, hiding, and judgment · core · Genesis 3:22–24
points.right: Adam in 2 Esdras · later memory · 2 Esdras 7:10–12

payload.posture: Genesis guards the way to the tree of life; 2 Esdras says the present world became narrow and toilsome.

rightEvidence.title: The world’s narrow way is linked to Adam

payload.tension: The later account expands one expulsion into a description of the world’s condition.
payload.title: The guarded way and the narrowed world
